rules.statement: A sale or mortgage executed during the pendency of a partition suit in respect of a share or interest, to which a person may become entitled after the termination of such suit, is valid and not affected by section 17 of Ordinance No. 10 of 1863.
rules.supporting_quote: A sale or mortgage executed during the pendency of a partition suit in respect of a share or interest, to which a person may become entitled after the partition suit has terminated, appears to me not affected by section 17.
